title: Does anyone have an old style town accessible only by a bridge that has some almost unnavigable scary spots?
content: But then you get there and it's just old school vibes. Like the 50's beach vibe. Like 1960's Tarpon Springs, Florida area. Mine has little open court yard houses and motels like 1950's cheap Miami vibe. I haven't had that dream in a long time but I've gone to that place repeatedly over the years I'm in my mid forties. I only ask this here because I'm less likely to sound like a crazy person in this sub, and because I finally started googling some stuff only to find that the mall is a place where a lot of us go... How weird. This bridge/road trip dream to this "postcard vacation land beyond the scary mega bridge/highway" my "underground kinda cave/parking garage/sidewalk under the mall and former employee" dream, as well as "loose tooth/teeth/falling out dreams", being able to "fly/swing/climb with my hands" and vividly see the tops of buildings roads from above, etc... I think those are the only reoccurring things in my dreams. Sometimes I see my Dad (who died when I was 18) drive by or I find him... Finding out that he didn't die, but just left us and has another family and life. That one's gotten even weirder since my mom passed away a little over two years ago. Because now I have dreams where he's split up from her and living with another woman or family or something. We always get him to stop doing whatever bad thing he's doing and come home, but it never works out and he "dies again" or runs off. Story for this post, or question, or whatever it is... I just finally decided to see why my dreams are so weird and few and far betwen..
